name: propresenter-garage
description: A suite of utilities for ProPresenter 7 files. Runs entirely in your browser.

scripts.dev: npm run protos && npm run dev -w @propresenter-garage/web --
scripts.build: npm run protos && npm run build -w @propresenter-garage/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/core && tsc --noEmit -p packages/core/tsconfig.test.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/web && tsc --noEmit -p packages/web/tsconfig.test.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json
scripts.check: npm run protos && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
